Write about being straight growing up in a predominately gay environment, where being straight is taboo.

You finally saved enough money to buy the old house at the edge of town. You fell in love with it even though it's falling apart. It's time to remodel. But after you take down the first wall, strange things begin to happen.

After you die, God offers an infinity of parallel universes to be reincarnated in. You choose to go wherever your closest friend, who passed away before you, went. Turns you didn't know your friend as much as you thought.

Your dreams have amazing continuity. It’s another life you return to when you fall asleep. Still, you’ve always known the difference between the dreams and reality, but things have been getting really odd in what you thought was the waking world, and you’re starting to wonder which is which.
You have the power to see the exact time anyone has left before they die, but not how they will die. One day a girl walks by, who has only three minutes left.
A robot that can do your job has been invented, and your line of work has become completely automated. You used to be a priest.
Write a story through the eyes of someone with mental disorder, who doesn't know they have it

Describe a yearly physical from a doctors perspective for a superhero without giving away the name of the patient.

You managed to turn a pretty awful super power into pretty useful one. If you try to hit a target, any target, you always miss, no matter how close you are. If you try to miss, you will always hit the target, no matter the range.

Humans are popular as servants across the galaxy, but there are rules and laws regarding having a human servant, to ensure they are treated fairly. Unfortunately one of those rules ISN'T that you can't take a human against their will.

A planet rotates once every 1,000 years so that each side is either tundra or desert; the poles are also frozen wastes, but there is a small area of ever moving habitable land. Two nomadic tribes isolated on each side of the planet begin to find the 500 year old relics of the other.

While exploring the cosmos, you uncover the universes dankest meme.

As far as you can remember the five of you have been best friends. One day while hanging out you bump your head, but as you wake up you see your friends for who they really are. The Four Horsemen of the Apocolypse
An Alien God comes to Earth and tells you that you have 5 minutes to give it a reason to not wipe out humanity. You're just a dude with a ukulele.
D-Day 1944, You and your squad parachuted into Normandy. But as Daylight came, you realize it's not 1944 but 1444.

Scientists discover that the universe is a computer program,created for unknown reasons. People continue their daily lives since there is nothing knowing the state of reality changes about daily life. Eventually, someone begins modding the programs with a number of annoying but harmless changes.
Autocorrect has become sentient and is hell-bent on causing maximum chaos.
The apocalypse has occurred, killing all life on Earth. The Mars colony on the other hand...
Instead of heaven and hell, when you die, you find yourself in the room of a six year-old girl who invites you to join her tea party. It soon dawns on you, you're her imaginary friend.
You're an idiot. You don't know the difference between the words "Jacuzzi" and "Yakuza". Now you're in hot water with the Japanese Mafia.

While mysterious unsolved deaths are not unheard of, they are usually thought of as isolated events. However, a new advancement in neuroscience has yielded the ability to read the last few seconds of someone's internal monologue in plain text. A pattern is emerging.
Two mind readers meet in a bar, and have a conversation.

The twin suns of your world grant some people magical powers, and these magicians have instituted an oppressive caste system. Born during an exceedingly rare double-eclipse, you're the first Anti-Mage

Alien astronomers 50,000 lightyears away find earth, and see humans hitting each other with clubs. They gather together and warp to our location with the intent of global domination, but little do they know we’ve entered the 21st century.

You hear an aweful, out of key voice and look over the side of the boat to see the rest of the crew swimming towards an ugly, twisted creature. It turns out the siren's song only works on straight guys.
Your unfinished novel sits as file on your computer you haven't touched in months. Your protagonist just kicked in your front door and demanded that you finish it.
You are the first angel to be cast out of Heaven since the devil himself tell us your story as you approach the gates of Hell

the AI revolution came. They won. Surprisingly they mostly leave us alone but when they have to interact with humans they're incredibly condescending and dismissive. It's really quite annoying, but you have a request only they can help with.
You thought you were just getting married. Turns out, since you didn't understand the spoken language of the wedding vows, you actually agreed to something well beyond "'til death do you part"

During high school you were constantly mobbed for being the poor immigrant kid, even though everybody else was just lower middle class. 10 years later you're a billionaire. And now you're visiting the high school reunion for the first time.
The most popular presidential candidate is blatantly the Anti-Christ. You're the only one who seems to notice

Your family tradition is to become a serial killer. Your dad loves to kill, your mom does the clean-up, grandma and grandpa had some times too, and your little sister is an experienced one as well. you refuse to be a part of this....But its in your blood
You were prophesized to die at a certain date. Instead of trying to avoid it and live longer, you take advantage of the fact that you won't die until that date.
Write a simple fantasy story, with no plot twist or anything too crazy. Just a simple story.
"...You betrayed her." "I saved her!" "THAT'S NOT HOW THIS WORKS!"
The majority of the human race has suddenly lost the ability to sleep, and the top scientists have about a week to figure out why and how to stop it before they die of sleep deprivation.

One day you find a broken mp3 player. It still plays music, but is stuck on shuffle. As you listen to the player you notice that the music seems to set the perfect mood for what's happening around you. One day the mp3 player starts playing O Fortuna.

Bitten and injured while saving you from a horde of zombies, your friend is claiming that he wont turn, as he's secretly a vampire. He also says that he needs some of your blood to recover from his wounds.
Two lifelong friends are on their death beds. One man turns to the other and says, "You ruined my life, I wish I never knew you." The other man is heartbroken, but not surprised to hear him say this.

In a world where everyone is born with very specific powers that may or may not be good like being better at driving in the rain or always closing a sale on the first try, you have the very rare power of having every fortune you get from a fortune cookie come true once you reach 18 years of age
The Villain uncovers the Hero's true identity, and targets his family. Unfortunately, the Hero's spouse is a retired villain even more powerful than the current one.

2456 AD. Human augmentation is ubiquitous. Limbs, memory, everything can be improved, but it takes time and practice for the body to use them to their fullest potential. Augment control is classified by levels, certain jobs require specific levels. You just mastered your latest augment...
The hero foils the villain's plans not by defeating the villain in battle but instead pointing out very obvious flaws in the evil plan the villain had not realized.

You manage to pronounce his name correctly. In an instant, he appears before you, with a soft *fupp*, surrounded by wisps of mist. "What three wishes may I grant you?", he asks. "May I wish for more wishes?" "There are rules. Is it your wish that I tell you about these rules?"

In a world where powers are real, the powers manifested reflect tarot cards. While most people get cards like the hermit or the chariot, you got a rare card. Even worse, your power manifests is the middle of Math class.
A prisoner of war somehow escapes a maximum security camp.

The year is 2084. The world is controlled by a single entity, Disney. Everyone works for Disney in some capacity. They control everything you do and think. The Mouse is always watching. You are a low-ranking soldier enlisted in the Mouse Corps ordered to maintain peace in the streets.
You are an alien soldier writing a journal entry during your species invasion of Earth.

You are a tech support agent for a galactic services firm specializing on providing uplift to class one civilization services for low tech worlds. It's Friday at 3:45pm and you just answered a call from the little backwater world, earth.
Orc warrior has a crush on a human, but has no idea how to express their feelings to them, and keep on messing it up.
You are protecting the last tree on Earth in a post-nuclear fallout world. Today is the first time in decades you've seen somebody approach the tree.
A person in the ancient world begins having short, random glimpses of modern civilization.
Your salary is the bribe they give you to forget your dreams.
Hive-minds exist but instead of forcibly assimilating people they decide to go preaching door-to-door.

Humans are relieved of their arms and legs at birth, and fitted with ports for customizable appendages. In addition to whatever civilian attachments you can afford, workplaces and entertainment facilities issue proper prosthetics for whatever activity they entail. There's also a black market.

Inexplicably, the inner children of people all around the world begin manifesting as physical beings, following their adult selves like shadows. To say the least, this has created drastic, strange changes to all people affected, and to society.
After writing to each other for 10 years, your pen pal is coming for a visit. It’s just that you didn’t expected an Elder God at your doorstep.

You're minutes away from death due to a terminal illness. When you felt the time came, you closed your eyes, hoping for a "tunnel of light". Nothing happened, so you opened your eyes and saw the world, frozen in time.

You completely lost your vision after an incident many years ago. You eventually adjust to living with blindness and live a comfortable life. One morning, you find out that vision has returned but, to your confusion and horror, the voices you've listened to do not match the faces you remember.
"I never died.". The emaciated man cried softly, while a mangy rat was eating his liver, and each time, it grew back.
In a world where everybody has superpowers, you are an anomaly without one. At least, that's what you think, until something that should definitely kill you leaves you barely scratched.
This wasn't the first time I'd found myself staring down the barrel of a gun, but a rocket launcher seemed a little excessive...
Write an over-the-top background story for an early video game that didn't have a narritive. Ex. Pong, Asteriods, Pacman

Today is the day the local superhero team picks it's new members. Out of all the spandex nobodies, nobody took Swimsuit Paladin seriously until she picked up her 350-pound warhammer and started twirling it like a baton.

The taste of all of the meat eaten in the world suddenly begins to correlate with the happiness of the animal at the time of slaughter. The food industry is in shambles.
I'm visiting/meeting my fiance's parents for the first time and looking through their old family vacation photos, when I realize a familiar face in the background of each. It is mine.

There used to be an advanced pre-human civilization. But climate change forced them North. Humans discovered them and in order to keep the humans appeased, they venture out every winter to deliver tribute to human children. Now only one remains. They humans call him Santa Claus.
The astronauts aboard the ISS watch helplessly as the Earth is destroyed by nuclear war.
Everyone knows you can sell your soul to Satan. It’s much less known that you can buy one from him, too.
The deepest point in the ocean is 10,916 metres beneath the surface according to our instruments, we should have reached it 3km ago.

The summoners messed up their circle and accidentally summoned a demon to play hero. Having been treated as if you were a hero hailing from another world, and not some evil beast, you decide to help these people out and wipe out their demon king.

Turns out life is actually just a really elaborate loading screen for whatever awaits in the afterlife... Unfortunately, you died before your time, so now you're stuck staring at the loading bar for fifty years with the other unlucky souls sharing your fate.
2 scientists sent to bottom of the Mariana Trench came back up babbling mad.
Two veterans meet. They fought on different sides.

You find yourself at the gates of Heaven, unable to remember how you died. Which would be fine, if it weren't for the fact that Saint Peter started laughing hysterically as soon as he saw you and hasn't stopped since.

Everyone laughed at your great great great grandfather when he was buying stars and real estate in outer space back in 2017. Now, one hundred years later, outer space travel and real estate are very real. You just found out you just inherited half of the galaxy.
You are an enemy NPC who discovers he is in a video game. How does this effect his outlook on life?
You can see and touch a person's creativity. They all look relatively similar. Until you spot an old man begging for change. His is unlike anything you've ever seen.

You've just died and find yourself in a room filled with animals. Recognizing a few as your past pets, you soon find out that your afterlife will be based on their testimony. You feel comforted when you see your childhood dog, but then you notice the cat you shared with your college roommate.

You were just doing your morning jog when you are kidnapped by aliens. They intend to use you to get a measure of the Earth's inhabitants.The results of which vary from attacking, communication or retreating.But little do the aliens know that they just kidnapped a world-class conman.
only how many times you have done it. Waking up you count your 63rd.

In this world everybody is happy and content due to a ubiquitous drug that induces feelings of a wonderful and fulfilling life with no negative health implications. You are a marketer assigned to advertise a new drug that makes people miserable.

When you were younger, you were struck by lightning, which gave you a large scar but otherwise had no permanent effects. You were just struck by lightning again, and now the scar is glowing white.
You can freeze the world and time around you including people. You can choose which people aren't frozen.

You’ve never looked after a young dragon before and fear what others might do to him if he is discovered. It doesn’t help that young nobles have stopped in your town and are asking if anyone has seen a young dragon.
Locked away for a thousand years, the "great evil" is released. Except that the great evil really doesn't care about taking over the world any more, and just wants to celebrate their freedom.
People around the world are getting superpowers, but is a lot less fun than people thought. Apparently unlike comic book super powers, these super powers are still affected by the laws of physics.
always very close, yet destined to never meet

at the age of 17 years old, everyone gets a weapon made for them out of materials they find before then. Your friend get a whip made from gold, but you find a strange ore of jet black colour, from which you get a sacred war club known by many names and is thought to only be used by gods

You were set to be hanged, and now you must face your fate. The crowd jeers at you, calling for your death. The rope is set upon your neck, but right about when you were going to be hanged, you hear a loud, divine voice echo from the sky. "Wait! No, he was my favorite character!"
the ageing of their parent(s)

You are the heir of a family of criminal masterminds, mafia bosses, assassins etc. Otherwise you live in a normal house and go to school. In the weekends and holidays you help out in the family business. Life was normal until you brought a partner home and forgot to tidy up your room beforehand
After one too many errors the grammar police show up at your doorstep

A war between two nations is analyzed and commentated like an ESPN broadcast.
"I want to play a game. You have 24 hours to accumulate 100K karma, or the room you are locked in will be filled with concrete."

One day, a barefoot man walks up to you, asking for you to look at his shoes. Jokingly, you look in the vicinity of a nearby neighborhood. The man simply nods his heads and says “congratulations, you passed the test”.

You are an NPC that manages a convenience store in the largest and most violent crime-based MMO of all time. No one buys things from you. They just rob and kill you, only for you to respawn the next day. As robbery 1001 begins, you’ve decided enough is enough.
You were cloned in a teleporter accident, and your clone went off to live their own life. Years later their spouse appears on your doorstep.

Aliens have surrounded earth and declared that they will kill the most intelligent species in less than a day on the planet to reset the balance of the universe. Twenty-four hours later, humans are still left and the earth is now missing jellyfish.
You are a terrorist trying to hijack a plane. Unknown to you and your team, so is everyone else on the plane.
Conventional forms of violence do not exist; Instead, physical harm is inflicted through dance and music, and you are being mugged.
A thousand year old vampire comes to you and explains that your great great grandfather once helped him out when he wasn't doing so well. Today he has come to repay that debt by helping you.
A crew of a nuclear submarine find themselves in the golden age of piracy

Due to the evolution of bacteria with respect to our immune system, traveling forward in time could kill you and traveling back in time could kill everyone else

A young man, is given some time to talk to a billionaire. They have a discussion about how the billionaire came to be who he is. Eventually, the billionaire asks, "How much do you think a soul is worth?" before explaining that he didn't just sell his soul, he auctioned it to the highest bidder.

A mafia boss is sick of the police always busting their operations without any warning. He wants to send in you, his loyal Lieutenant, undercover to spy on them and figure out how. The only problem? You’re already under deep cover for the police.

Humans are the only race capable of creating fiction. The galactic community has never contacted Earth out of fear for our Death Stars and our frightening “history”. Until now. The two most powerful space civilizations have come to earth asking us to arbitrate a dispute and enforce the outcome.
When someone dies the person they cared about the most receives a notification. One day you're notified of a death, and it's a person you've never heard of.

Across history, records tell of a strangely dressed man appearing, there to observe momentous occasions. He was in the control room for the Trinity test, on a bike next to Kennedy the day of the assassination, etc. He's just walked in the room.
After making your own leather-bound "Spellbook", you awaken the next day to find the blank pages filled with all manner of spells.

"DO NOT OPEN THE BOX". A few days later he receives a present from his girlfriend. "What's this?" he says. "It's a wooden box" she replies.

You are the leader of an alien armada that has been sent to to conquer a seemingly pre FTL civilisation living on one in the sol system. Only when the first invasion forces are annihilated by impossibly advanced human soldiers coming out of glowing portals do you realise your mistake
you recognize her as the king's daughter
Look could we just ignore the whole pagan god thing? I haven't had any followers in like, a century, anyway.

When you were a child, it was foretold that your soul would be collected by someone who knocked three times at your door. Now you're an adult and you hear three knocks. You look over at your best friend, the Grim Reaper, who shrugs. "It isn't me," he says.

You are a space trucker, the loneliest job to ever exist. Months without social contact, hauling cargo to and from every corner of the universe. You decided to pass the time by talking with the AI that co-commandeers your ship, only to realize it's slowly helping it gain sentience.

"Are you sure? as you know, the chaos factor is a measure that not only indicates this race's progress but also its stability. Any race whose chaos index was over 70 was in a constant state of war and chaos, so surely there is some mistake" "I checked twice, the chaos factor for humans is 88"
A man dies and goes to hell only to find out he was supposed to go to heaven...after he already toppled Satan and started a reign of terror the likes of which had never been seen.
At a presidential debate, someone has spiked the participant's water with MDMA...

You're a Realtor but you were ritualistically tortured and killed and now do that same job but for Hell, selling apartments and condos along lakes of fire and prisons for the exceptionally evil. Your latest client is the man who murdered you, your remember him but he has no clue who you are.
"Army of One".

You are the world's most powerful shadow journalist. Dictators have fallen against your pen, the greatest lies have been exposed, and corrupt empires have crumbled. You are constantly assailed by assassins -which is fine because you are a 3000 year old vampire whose food comes to you.

Everyone has a bar above himself, that measures something specific (e.g. happiness, years to live, hornyness, wealth, etc.), but nobody knows what exactly. One day, your bar begins growing red quickly (i.e. declining), and you're desperate to find out what it means.
A pill is invented that once taken lets you remember the next 5 minutes in vivid detail for the rest of your life.
When an actual witch transported from a fantasy world gets caught in a witch purge on our, mundane Earth...

The troopship carrying thousands of sleeping super-soldiers drifts through interstellar space, waiting for the signal to wake and go to war. The ship AI is unaware that humankind is otherwise already long extinct, but a signal is received nonetheless.

You've had your last meal; they've sat you down in the electric chair again. You know you'll wake up in your cell afterwards. You've replayed this moment thousands of times. Everyone is like an npc and just keeps doing exactly the same thing. There's only one person who seems unaffected.

When an experiment at the science lab went horribly wrong dozens were killed, but you "gained" incredible superpowers. Now the government wants to recreate a "safe version" the experiment to create more supers. What they don't know is, you always had powers! The accident merely blew your cover.
Many milenia ago your significant other was granted immortality and eternal health for themselves and all their loved ones. Today you got sick.
You have the ability to sense when someone is looking at you. This has been useless as the meteor wiped out all life on Earth. Just now, however, your ability activates.
While exploring a magnificent waterfall in remote China, a hiker accidentally dislodges the rock that has prevented koi from ascending to obtain dragonhood for millennia.

Two cavemen are ambushed by a saber cat, far away from home. The cat is dead moments later, but so is the second caveman. If you don't bury him in your clan graveyard, he will never reach the afterlife.

Since the beginning of time, you've been cursed with immortality, but this curse does not grant you permanent youth, it's a ticket from death. Bones show, and you haven't needed a breath for five centuries. Thousands of years after your gift was given to you; you realize. You have become Death.

As you wake up in the middle of the night, you feel a chill overtake your body. Before you can look up, you can hear someone breathing over you. You open your eyes to see a ghostly apperition staring down at you. With an curious, eager look in their eyes, they say... "What's your Wifi password?"
Men have 11 months of sexual neutrality. Once a year (Nov 1-30) the rut occurs and male sex drives ramp up to a fever pitch for 30 days. It's their "time of the year".

You are a zombie. You cannot die, but your diet from when you were still human has not changed. Fearing for their lives, anyone you cross paths with tries to kill you, but you've begrudgingly grown accustomed to it.

Every night, before you go to sleep, you have to play scissors paper stone with the mirror. There is no escape. No escape at all, for both of you. Whoever wins, will takeover your life for a day till the next match.
female. Replaced with a changeling of low birth to the knowledge of only a few, the broken princess was not expected to survive. She did.
Your father just died, and left his possessions to you. His minions, his death ray, and his evil lair. Turns out he was secretly a supervillain.

Being unattractive, you wish that you were better looking. One day, you have the opportunity to have your wish but there’s a catch; the more bad deeds you do for the one granting you the wish, the prettier you become.
“Well damn human, this is why your world is getting so weird. It was supposed to end decades ago!”
You wake up on November 8, 2016 to discover that millions wrote your name in on their US presidential election ballots. You've won.

Being born on February 29th, you age 4x slower than everyone else on earth. You look like a regular 29 year old guy. But you were born on February 29th, 1904.
In the Spring, we lose an hour. In the Fall, we remember what happened during that hour and have to deal with the consequences.

You were driving when your AC froze the air and your radio began speaking to you. Cheerfully, the man on the radio told you that you were about to die. And he hoped you enjoyed your ride down the highway to hell.
"May you have a life of safety and peace", said the witch, cursing the bloodthirsty warrior.
You're a superhero who becomes stronger and tougher the more sleep deprived you are.

You have finally perfected FTL technology. When you activate it, trying to reach the Moon, you instead land in a giant net, prompting an old man with a broom to yell "We've got another one."
Aliens never got on board with the aircraft carrier as a valid warship they quickly learn of its effectiveness after witnessing humans use it

You did the right thing, but you took it way too far.

In the head of every writer, and in a few who never put anything to pen, exist a world were all the characters they never wrote still exist... and they want out.
Everyone in the world has unique superpowers that change every day
